concerns.text: Spec acceptance scenario US-01.2 requires extracting session-cluster structure from the UCI Online Retail dataset and assigning treatment labels maintaining that structure. No task fetches, checksums, or uses that dataset; the completed generator is purely synthetic and the plan marks data/raw/ as '(Optional)'. This is a silent retroactive narrowing of a spec acceptance criterion — either add a task covering it or amend the spec to document the descope.

T104(b) verifies 'empirical error rate for standard_t at ICC 0 lies inside its Clopper-Pearson CI' — trivially true by construction (the CI is computed around that estimate), so the check can never fail and the spec's ICC=0 edge case is effectively unverified. The criterion must be that the NOMINAL alpha lies within the Clopper-Pearson interval.

concerns.text: Constitution Principle III requires every file under data/ to be checksummed in the state YAML artifact_hashes map, and the plan's structure declares data/checksums.txt. No remaining task (T101–T107) produces or updates checksums for the new data/results/ and data/derived/ outputs. Add a checksumming step (e.g. fold into T106).

The data model declares data/derived/simulation_results_raw.csv, aggregated_metrics.csv, and config_snapshot.json as the result artifacts, but tasks read/write baseline_results.csv, robustustResults.csv (sic — 'robustResults.csv'), simulation_config_log.csv, and data/results/final_report.csv. The committed data model does not describe the files the tasks actually produce; reconcile the artifact names (and the camelCase 'robustResults.csv' drift) in data-model.md or the tasks.

Constitution I requires reproducibility 'on a fresh GitHub Actions runner'; T106 only re-runs the workflow in the existing environment. Platform CI provisioning is out of scope (T007 removal is fine), but T106 should at least verify reproducibility from a clean venv built from requirements.txt to approximate the fresh-runner condition.
